source.title: Pathfinder Adventure: The Fall of Plaguestone

items.name: Motion Sense (Precise) 30 feet
items.text: A mutant wolf can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

items.name: Gore Spray
items.text:
Trigger A creature critically hits a mutant wolf while adjacent to it.

---

Effect The wound causes gore to spray from a ruptured pustule. The triggering creature takes 3d6 acid damage (DC 19 basic Reflex save save). This occurs even if the attack kills the wolf.

items.name: Tear
items.text:
Trigger The wolf dealt damage to a creature with its jaws during the previous action.

---

Effect The wolf tears at the creature's flesh, dealing 1d6+2 slashing damage and 1 persistent acid damage.
